uuid.title: UUID Generator Tool
uuid.intro: A UUID generator that creates random UUID v4 unique identifiers, supporting formats with and without hyphens, batch generation and one-click copy
uuid.problem1: Generate UUID unique identifiers supporting multiple versions.
uuid.problem2: Simplify tedious manual operations to improve efficiency and accuracy.
uuid.problem3: No professional software required; use it online anytime, anywhere.
uuid.formatV1: UUID v1: Full processing support for this format.
uuid.formatV4: UUID v4: Full processing support for this format.
uuid.featureOnline: Online processing: All operations run in your browser; no downloads or installation required.
uuid.featurePreview: Real-time preview: Results are displayed instantly for easy adjustment and confirmation.
uuid.featureExport: One-click export: Quickly export processed files or copy results.
uuid.featureSecurity: Data security: All data is processed locally and never uploaded to any server.
uuid.usageSetCount: Set the number: Enter how many UUIDs to generate at once in the "Number to Generate" box, from 1 to 20.
uuid.usageSelectFormat: Choose the format: Select the "With Hyphens" or "Without Hyphens" format.
uuid.usageClickGenerate: Click to generate: Click the "Generate UUIDs" button to create random UUIDs.
uuid.usageViewResult: View results: The generated UUIDs appear in the "Generated Results" area.
uuid.usageCopySingle: Copy a single UUID: Click the "Copy" button next to a UUID to copy it individually.
uuid.usageCopyAll: Copy all UUIDs: Click the "Copy All UUIDs" button to copy all generated UUIDs, one per line.
uuid.usageFormatWithHyphen: With hyphens: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx, containing 4 hyphens, 36 characters in total.
uuid.usageFormatNoHyphen: Without hyphens: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx, no hyphens, 32 characters in total.
uuid.usageVersion: Version info: This tool generates UUID v4, which is random and contains no timestamp information.
uuid.usageVariant: Variant info: Uses the variant defined by the RFC 4122 standard.
uuid.usageBaseDef: UUID definition: A UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a universally unique identifier used to uniquely identify objects in distributed systems.
uuid.usageBaseV1: UUID v1: Generated from timestamps and MAC addresses; may leak device information.
uuid.usageBaseV4: UUID v4: Generated from random numbers; the most commonly used version with high security.
uuid.usageBaseUniqueness: Uniqueness: The probability of a UUID v4 collision is extremely low, about 1/(2^122), so they can be considered unique in practice.
uuid.usageBaseUsage: Use cases: Database primary keys, distributed system IDs, session identifiers, file naming, etc.
uuid.noteSecurity1: All processing is done entirely in your local browser; no data is uploaded to any server.
uuid.noteSecurity2: Generated UUIDs are for reference only; do not use them directly in security-critical scenarios.
uuid.noteSecurity3: Although the probability of a UUID v4 collision is extremely low, duplicates are still possible in extreme cases; check uniqueness before use.
uuid.noteFormat1: The hyphenated format is more readable and suitable for log records and manual review.
uuid.noteFormat2: The non-hyphenated format takes less space and is suitable for storage and transmission.
uuid.noteFormat3: The two formats are interchangeable by simply adding or removing hyphens.
uuid.noteAdvice1: When using UUIDs as database primary keys, prefer the non-hyphenated format to save storage space.
uuid.noteAdvice2: When returning UUIDs in API responses, prefer the hyphenated format, which complies with the RFC standard.
uuid.noteAdvice3: For batch generation, generate no more than 10 UUIDs at a time to avoid page lag.
uuid.noteFaq1: Invalid count: The number of UUIDs to generate ranges from 1 to 20; adjust the parameter.
uuid.noteFaq2: Copy failed: Check that your browser allows clipboard access.
uuid.noteFaq3: Duplicate UUIDs: Although the probability is extremely low, if you worry about duplicates, verify them against the database before use.
uuid.noteFaq4: Format conversion: You can switch between the two formats by manually adding or removing hyphens.
uuid.noteFaq5: UUID version: This tool generates UUID v4, which contains no timestamp information.
